assistant.skills.audienceAgents.description: A Combwork skill's badge: the project agents get it.

assistant.skills.audienceAgentsTip.defaultMessage: For the project agents: every agent in every project of this workspace gets it. The Assistant doesn't. This is the default; to change it, set audience under metadata: in its SKILL.md's header (assistant, or all for both).
assistant.skills.audienceAgentsTip.description: Tooltip on Project agents. Keep the <code> tags and what is inside them (audience, metadata:, assistant, all) as they are, and SKILL.md.

assistant.skills.audienceAll.description: A Combwork skill's badge: the project agents and the Combwork Assistant get it. Keep it short.

assistant.skills.audienceAllTip.defaultMessage: For both the project agents (every agent in every project) and the Assistant (audience: all in its SKILL.md's header).
assistant.skills.audienceAllTip.description: Tooltip on Agents + Assistant. Keep the <code> tags and audience: all inside them as they are, and SKILL.md.

assistant.skills.audienceAssistant.description: A Combwork skill's badge: the Combwork Assistant gets it.

assistant.skills.audienceAssistantTip.defaultMessage: For the Assistant only (audience: assistant in its SKILL.md's header). Project agents don't get it.
assistant.skills.audienceAssistantTip.description: Tooltip on Assistant. Keep the <code> tags and audience: assistant inside them as they are, and SKILL.md.

assistant.skills.copied.description: A notice: a skill was copied into the workspace's Combwork skills.

assistant.skills.copiedDetail.defaultMessage: {audience, select, assistant {The Assistant now gets it} all {The project agents and the Assistant now get it} other {The project agents now get it}} as a Combwork skill, from their next session.
assistant.skills.copiedDetail.description: Under Copied … to the workspace: who gets it now.

assistant.skills.copiedNobody.defaultMessage: Copied "{name}" to the workspace, but nobody gets it yet
assistant.skills.copiedNobody.description: A notice: a skill was copied into the workspace's Combwork skills, but its header can't be read.

assistant.skills.copiedNobodyDetail.defaultMessage: Its header needs fixing first: {problem}. Open it in the Skills view to edit it.
assistant.skills.copiedNobodyDetail.description: Under Copied … but nobody gets it yet. {problem} says what is wrong with the skill's header.

assistant.skills.copy.description: A button over a user's or project's skill: copies it into the Combwork skills.

assistant.skills.copyFailed.description: An error notice: a skill couldn't be copied into the workspace; the reason follows.

assistant.skills.copyTip.defaultMessage: Copy it into the workspace's Combwork skills. The project agents in every project get it, unless its SKILL.md's header sets another audience.
assistant.skills.copyTip.description: Tooltip on Copy to workspace. Keep SKILL.md as it is.

assistant.skills.create.description: The New Skill dialog: its button.

assistant.skills.delete.description: Confirmation before a skill is deleted: its button.

assistant.skills.deleteFailed.description: An error notice: a skill couldn't be deleted; the reason follows.

assistant.skills.deleteHive.defaultMessage: It's removed from the workspace, so new sessions of {audience, select, assistant {the Assistant} all {the project agents and the Assistant} other {the project agents}} no longer get it. A running Claude Code session keeps its own copy until it restarts. Codex sessions share the copy in their folder: a running one loses it when another Codex session in that folder starts.
assistant.skills.deleteHive.description: Confirmation before a Combwork skill is deleted: who loses it and when.

assistant.skills.deleteLocal.defaultMessage: {known, select, yes {{provider} agents} other {The agents}} in this project no longer load it in new sessions.
assistant.skills.deleteLocal.description: Confirmation before a project's own skill is deleted. {provider} is Claude Code, Codex…

assistant.skills.deleteMessage.description: Confirmation before a skill is deleted. {name} is the skill.

assistant.skills.deleteNobody.defaultMessage: It's removed from the workspace. Nobody gets it now ({problem}), so no session loses it.
assistant.skills.deleteNobody.description: Confirmation before a Combwork skill nobody gets is deleted. {problem} says what is wrong with its header.

assistant.skills.deleteTip.description: A trash button over an open skill: deletes it.

assistant.skills.deleteTitle.description: Confirmation before a skill is deleted: its title.

assistant.skills.deletedBadge.description: A badge on a skill of Combwork's own that was deleted from the workspace.

assistant.skills.deletedHere.description: A badge over a skill of Combwork's own that was deleted from the workspace.

assistant.skills.delivered.failed.description: A notice: switching a skill on or off for agents (Delivered to agents) failed. {name} is the skill.

assistant.skills.delivered.offInWorkspac.defaultMessage: Off in the workspace's Skills view, so no project's agents get it. Turn it on there first.
assistant.skills.delivered.offInWorkspac.description: Tooltip on a Combwork skill's switch in a project's Skills tab, shown off and disabled: the skill is switched off for the whole workspace.

assistant.skills.delivered.switch.description: A Combwork skill's switch in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab (Delivered to agents), for screen readers: whether agents are given the skill. {name} is the skill.

assistant.skills.delivered.tipProject.defaultMessage: Delivered to agents: on, this project's agents get this skill from their next session; off, they don't, and Combwork removes its copies at their next launch.
assistant.skills.delivered.tipProject.description: Tooltip on a Combwork skill's switch in a project's Skills tab.

assistant.skills.delivered.tipWorkspace.defaultMessage: Delivered to agents: on, every project's agents get this skill from their next session; off, none of them do, and Combwork removes its copies at their next launch.
assistant.skills.delivered.tipWorkspace.description: Tooltip on a Combwork skill's switch in the workspace's Skills view.

assistant.skills.editInWorkspace.description: A button over a Combwork skill in a project: opens it in the Skills view.

assistant.skills.editTip.defaultMessage: Combwork skills are edited in the workspace's Skills view, since every project shares them. This takes you there.
assistant.skills.editTip.description: Tooltip on Edit in workspace, over a Combwork skill in a project.

assistant.skills.fileMessage.defaultMessage: Adds {file} to {where}. A .md becomes the skill's SKILL.md; a .zip is unpacked as the skill's folder.
assistant.skills.fileMessage.description: The Add Skill from File dialog. {file} is the file chosen; {where} where it goes ("the workspace (.combwork/skills)"). Keep .md, .zip and SKILL.md as they are.

assistant.skills.fileTitle.description: The Add Skill from File dialog's title.

assistant.skills.files.description: Accessible name of the row of tabs above a skill's page, one tab per file of the skill ({skill}: the skill's name): its SKILL.md and the reference files it links.

assistant.skills.filesMore.defaultMessage: Only the first {count, number} files are shown.
assistant.skills.filesMore.description: Shown after a skill's file tabs when the skill's folder has more files than Combwork lists ({count}: how many are shown).

assistant.skills.filesTip.defaultMessage: SKILL.md is what an agent reads when it uses the skill. The other files are read only when SKILL.md's link to them is needed.
assistant.skills.filesTip.description: Tooltip on the tabs of a skill's files: an agent reads SKILL.md whenever it uses the skill, and each reference file only when it follows SKILL.md's link to it.

assistant.skills.levelHive.description: A skill's kind, on a badge: one of the workspace's Combwork skills. Usually kept as Combwork.

assistant.skills.levelLocal.description: A skill's kind, on a badge: one in the project's folder, which the user manages.

assistant.skills.levelPlugin.description: A skill's kind, on a badge: one from a Claude Code plugin.

assistant.skills.levelUser.description: A skill's kind, on a badge: one in the user's own profile (~/.claude/skills).

assistant.skills.nameRule.description: A skill's name that can't be used.

assistant.skills.newMessage.defaultMessage: Creates {file} in {where}. Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
assistant.skills.newMessage.description: The New Skill dialog. {file} is <name>/SKILL.md, <name> standing for the name you type; {where} where it goes ("the workspace (.combwork/skills)").

assistant.skills.newTitle.description: The title of the dialog that creates a skill (a folder with a SKILL.md).

assistant.skills.notGiven.description: A badge on a Combwork skill nobody gets, because its header can't be read.

assistant.skills.notGivenTip.defaultMessage: Nobody gets this skill until its header is fixed: {problem}. A skill's header starts and ends with a --- line; for who gets it, put audience: agents, assistant or all under metadata:.
assistant.skills.notGivenTip.description: Tooltip on Not given: a Combwork skill whose header (SKILL.md's front matter) can't be read. {problem} says what is wrong. Keep ---, audience:, agents, assistant, all and metadata: as they are.

assistant.skills.readFailed.description: An error notice, adding a skill from a file.

assistant.skills.restore.description: A button: puts back a deleted skill of Combwork's own.

assistant.skills.restoreFailed.description: An error notice: a skill that ships with Combwork couldn't be put back; the reason follows.

assistant.skills.restored.description: A notice: a deleted skill of Combwork's own is back.

assistant.skills.revert.description: Confirmation before an edited skill is put back as Combwork ships it: its button.

assistant.skills.revertButton.description: A button over an edited skill of Combwork's own: puts it back as Combwork ships it.

assistant.skills.revertDetail.defaultMessage: The current copy goes to the Recycle Bin, so edits made to it can still be recovered from there.
assistant.skills.revertDetail.description: Confirmation before an edited skill is put back as Combwork ships it.

assistant.skills.revertMessage.defaultMessage: Replace the workspace's "{name}" with the version that ships with this version of Combwork?
assistant.skills.revertMessage.description: Confirmation before an edited skill is put back as Combwork ships it. {name} is the skill.

assistant.skills.revertTip.defaultMessage: This skill ships with Combwork, and this copy was edited. Combwork keeps edited copies as they are; unedited ones it updates itself.
assistant.skills.revertTip.description: Tooltip on Revert to default, over an edited skill that ships with Combwork.

assistant.skills.revertTitle.description: Confirmation before an edited skill that ships with Combwork is put back as Combwork ships it.

assistant.skills.reverted.description: A notice: an edited skill is back as Combwork ships it.

assistant.skills.shipped.boardHygiene.defaultMessage: Tidy the board as the Assistant: duplicates, unrecorded answers, stale blocked reasons. Use when asked to tidy the board.
assistant.skills.shipped.boardHygiene.description: What a skill that ships with Combwork (board-hygiene) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. Keep Combwork Assistant as Combwork names it. Decisions are what the user decided about a card, as the card shows them.

assistant.skills.shipped.cardLoop.defaultMessage: Work through cards in turn as their builder or reviewer, waiting at no cost. Use when told to work through or review cards (one or several) as a builder or reviewer, or given rounds.
assistant.skills.shipped.cardLoop.description: What a skill that ships with Combwork (card-loop) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. Builder and reviewer are the two sides of a card loop; rounds are a card's build-and-review cycles in it.

assistant.skills.shipped.coordinateAgent.defaultMessage: Run work across the workspace's agents as the Assistant: cards, briefs, starting agents, waiting, handing over, stalled cards. Use when asked to get agents working, start or continue a card, or check progress.
assistant.skills.shipped.coordinateAgent.description: What a skill that ships with Combwork (coordinate-agents) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. Keep Combwork Assistant as Combwork names it.

assistant.skills.shipped.generalist.defaultMessage: General work: understand, change carefully, prove it, report honestly. Use when no other skill fits, not for inbox lines.
assistant.skills.shipped.generalist.description: What a skill that ships with Combwork (generalist) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. It is for work outside the board's skills, such as whatever the user asks an agent in its pane. Inbox lines are the lines Combwork types into an agent's session when its inbox has something ("[CW] New in your inbox…"): that work names its own skill.

assistant.skills.shipped.handover.defaultMessage: Write a handover so a later session or another agent can carry on cold. Use when asked to wrap up for later, hand over or stop for the day. Readying a branch to merge is merge-ready.
assistant.skills.shipped.handover.description: What a skill that ships with Combwork (handover) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. merge-ready is another skill's name: keep it as it is.

assistant.skills.shipped.journal.defaultMessage: Keep your journal as the Assistant while it is on - what to write, recalling, superseding, the weekly digest and the scope. Use when something worth remembering happens, before deciding from memory, or when asked for a handover.
assistant.skills.shipped.journal.description: What a skill that ships with Combwork (journal) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. The journal is the Assistant's memory across sessions; use the word Combwork's settings use for it.

assistant.skills.shipped.licenceAudit.defaultMessage: Audit the licences of what ships: dependencies, vendored files, installer parts. Use when releasing or adding assets.
assistant.skills.shipped.licenceAudit.description: What a skill that ships with Combwork (licence-audit) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. Vendored files are other people's files a package carries inside it.

assistant.skills.shipped.mergeReady.defaultMessage: Get a branch ready to merge and merge it when asked, through the merge slot: commit, run the checks, compare with the base. Use when asked to finish up, ready a branch, or merge one ("merge X into Y", "merge this lane").
assistant.skills.shipped.mergeReady.description: What a skill that ships with Combwork (merge-ready) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. Branch, worktree, commit, merge and push are git's terms. The merge slot is Combwork's turn-taking for merges into a branch; the quoted requests are examples of what a user asks.

assistant.skills.shipped.pickUp.defaultMessage: Continue earlier work from its handover, checking it against the current state. Use when asked to continue, resume or pick up previous work, or to read a handover. Not for every new session.
assistant.skills.shipped.pickUp.description: What a skill that ships with Combwork (pick-up) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab.

assistant.skills.shipped.reviewAgentWork.defaultMessage: Review another agent's work (a card in Review, a branch, commits or uncommitted changes) and report findings without changing it. Use when asked to review, check or verify work.
assistant.skills.shipped.reviewAgentWork.description: What a skill that ships with Combwork (review-agent-work) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. Review is a column of the task board: use its name as the board shows it.

assistant.skills.shipped.runLanes.defaultMessage: Run a team as the Assistant: builder and reviewer lanes on card loops, planned by files, briefed and watched to their end. Use when there are three or more agents or several builder and reviewer pairs, when asked for lanes, or woken about one.
assistant.skills.shipped.runLanes.description: What a skill that ships with Combwork (run-lanes) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. A lane is a builder and a reviewer taking cards in turn (a card loop): use the words Combwork uses for them.

assistant.skills.shipped.splitWork.defaultMessage: Plan whether and how to divide a task between agents without conflicts, and save the plan. Use when asked how to split work between agents, to parallelise it, or to run several agents on it. Plans only: starting agents is separate.
assistant.skills.shipped.splitWork.description: What a skill that ships with Combwork (split-work) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab.

assistant.skills.shipped.triageReport.defaultMessage: Turn a reported problem into a card with evidence as the Assistant: cause first, then duplicates. Use when the user reports a problem.
assistant.skills.shipped.triageReport.description: What a skill that ships with Combwork (triage-report) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. Keep Combwork Assistant as Combwork names it.

assistant.skills.shipped.tuneSettings.defaultMessage: Explain and suggest Combwork's settings as the Assistant; change one only when the user agrees. Use when asked what a setting does or how to make Combwork behave differently, or when one would fix what you see.
assistant.skills.shipped.tuneSettings.description: What a skill that ships with Combwork (tune-settings) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab.

assistant.skills.shipped.useHiveApi.defaultMessage: A Combwork tool's cases in detail (tools.md), and Combwork's HTTP API for scripts. Use when a tool's description isn't enough, or to automate Combwork over HTTP: board and notes work uses the tools.
assistant.skills.shipped.useHiveApi.description: What a skill that ships with Combwork (use-cw-api) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. Keep HTTP and API; Combwork tools are the tools Combwork gives agents (cw_…).

assistant.skills.shipped.workOnCard.defaultMessage: Carry a card from Combwork's task board through its work, from Active to Review with a summary. Use when given a card to work on ("work on AM-12", a card Combwork started you on, more work on one back from Review). Not for reviewing one, nor a card loop (card-loop).
assistant.skills.shipped.workOnCard.description: What a skill that ships with Combwork (work-on-card) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. card-loop is another skill's name: keep it. Active and Review are stages of the task board (glossary 2.2): use their names as the board shows them. "work on AM-12" is what you would ask an agent: translate it.

assistant.skills.shipped.workspaceNote.defaultMessage: Record a lasting decision, convention or gotcha in the workspace's shared notes. Use when asked to remember or document something for later, or when other agents will need what you learned. Not for work in progress.
assistant.skills.shipped.workspaceNote.description: What a skill that ships with Combwork (workspace-note) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. Shared notes are Combwork's notes view: use its name as Combwork shows it.

assistant.skills.stillLocal.defaultMessage: {known, select, yes {{provider} agents} other {The agents}} here also still load the local copy until you delete it.
assistant.skills.stillLocal.description: Under Copied … to the workspace, for a project's own skill: the project's copy stays. {provider} is Claude Code, Codex…

assistant.skills.tipHive.defaultMessage: Combwork skills live in the workspace (.combwork/skills). Each goes to the project agents (every agent in every project, of every provider), to the Assistant, or to both, as the audience in its SKILL.md says (the project agents if it says none). Combwork copies them for each session when it starts, so edits reach new sessions. Add, edit and delete them in the Skills view.
assistant.skills.tipHive.description: Tooltip on the Combwork skills. Keep .combwork/skills, SKILL.md and audience as they are.

assistant.skills.tipLocal.defaultMessage: Skills in the project folder for one provider (.claude/skills for Claude Code, .agents/skills for Codex). That provider's agents load them in this project. You manage them: add, edit and delete them here.
assistant.skills.tipLocal.description: Tooltip on a project's own skills. Keep the paths as they are.

assistant.skills.tipPlugin.defaultMessage: Skills from Claude Code plugins you've installed. Claude Code agents always load them. Listed for reference; manage plugins in Claude Code.
assistant.skills.tipPlugin.description: Tooltip on Claude Code plugins' skills.

assistant.skills.tipUser.defaultMessage: Skills in your user profile (~/.claude/skills for Claude Code, ~/.codex/skills for Codex). That provider's agents always load them, in every project. Listed for reference; manage them outside Combwork.
assistant.skills.tipUser.description: Tooltip on the user's own skills. Keep the paths as they are.

assistant.skills.updateAvailable.description: A badge over an edited skill of Combwork's own when Combwork ships a newer version.

assistant.skills.updateBadge.description: A badge on an edited skill of Combwork's own when Combwork ships a newer version.

assistant.skills.updateTip.defaultMessage: This copy was edited, so Combwork didn't update it. This Combwork ships a newer version: Revert to default brings it in (your copy goes to the Recycle Bin).
assistant.skills.updateTip.description: Tooltip on Update available, over an edited skill. Revert to default is the button beside it.

assistant.skills.warning.defaultMessage: Warning: Editing these skills may change agent behaviour in Combwork
assistant.skills.warning.description: A banner over the Combwork skills and a Combwork skill being edited. <b> is bold.

assistant.skills.whereHive.description: Where a skill is added, inside New Skill and Add Skill from File: the Combwork skills. Lower case: it is part of a sentence.

assistant.skills.whereLocal.description: Where a skill is added, inside New Skill and Add Skill from File: a project's own skills of {provider} (Claude Code, Codex…). Lower case: it is part of a sentence.

assistant.status.also.defaultMessage: {line} · {also, select, approval {waiting for your approval} other {has a question for you}}
assistant.status.also.description: The Assistant panel's status line ({line}: what it is doing) with the user also wanted: one of Combwork's questions waits for their answer (approval), or the Assistant asked them something it works on through.

assistant.status.approval.description: The Assistant panel's status line: an action of the Assistant waits for the user's answer to one of Combwork's questions ({title}: the question, e.g. "Stop a busy agent?").

assistant.status.approvals.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Waiting for your approval (# question)} other {Waiting for your approval (# questions)}}
assistant.status.approvals.description: The Assistant panel's status line: its actions wait for the user's answers to {n} of Combwork's questions (always two or more).

assistant.status.background.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Waiting on # background task} other {Waiting on # background tasks}}
assistant.status.background.description: The Assistant panel's status line: its turn ended while {n} background tasks it started still run.

assistant.status.cards.defaultMessage: Waiting for {cards}{until, select, none {} other { (watch until {until})}}
assistant.status.cards.description: The Assistant panel's status line while it watches cards: the cards ({cards}: each a chip, "#12 #13") and until when ({until}: a time; none: leave that branch empty).

assistant.status.cardsInto.defaultMessage: Waiting for {cards} → {column}{until, select, none {} other { (watch until {until})}}
assistant.status.cardsInto.description: The Assistant panel's status line while it watches cards move into a board column: the cards ({cards}: each a chip, "#12 #13"), the column ({column}) and until when ({until}: a time; none: leave that branch empty).

assistant.status.error.description: The Assistant panel's status line: its CLI failed, with what it said ({message}; none: nothing said, leave the colon out).

assistant.status.idle.defaultMessage: {n, plural, =0 {Idle} one {Idle · # background task running} other {Idle · # background tasks running}}
assistant.status.idle.description: The Assistant panel's status line: its turn has ended, with {n} background tasks it started still running (0: none).

assistant.status.notRunning.description: The Assistant panel's status line (after "Status:"): its session isn't running.

assistant.status.onCards.description: The Assistant panel's status line: it waits for cards to change (a card watch).

assistant.status.signin.defaultMessage: Waiting for you to sign in
assistant.status.signin.description: The Assistant panel's status line: its CLI needs the user to sign in.

assistant.status.starting.description: The Assistant panel's status line: its session is starting.

assistant.status.untaken.defaultMessage: A line Combwork typed wasn't taken: press Enter in its terminal
assistant.status.untaken.description: The Assistant panel's status line: a line Combwork typed into the Assistant's terminal is still waiting there; the user presses Enter in it.

assistant.status.waiting.description: The Assistant panel's status line: it asks the user something, or a permission.

assistant.status.watch.description: The Assistant panel's status line while it watches agents or card loops: what it waits for ({watch}: "Waiting for B6 to finish"), and until when ({until}: a time; none: leave that branch empty).

assistant.status.working.description: The Assistant panel's status line: it is working on a turn.

assistant.template.agentNoName.defaultMessage: Agent {n} has no name (or one over 60 characters).
assistant.template.agentNoName.description: Why a template file can't be used: its agent number {n} (1, 2…) has no usable name.

assistant.template.badMcp.defaultMessage: {name}'s MCP servers aren't a list Combwork can use.
assistant.template.badMcp.description: Why a template file can't be used: an agent's list of MCP servers.

assistant.template.badName.defaultMessage: Its name is missing or longer than {max} characters.
assistant.template.badName.description: Why a template file can't be used: the template's name.

assistant.template.badPairs.defaultMessage: Its pairs of builders and reviewers name agents it doesn’t have, or an agent twice.
assistant.template.badPairs.description: Why a template file can't be used: its list of builders paired with reviewers (glossary: builder, reviewer) doesn't match its agents.

assistant.template.badRole.defaultMessage: {name}'s role in the workflow isn't builder, reviewer, either or generalist.
assistant.template.badRole.description: Why a template file can't be used: an agent's role in the workflow (glossary: builder, reviewer, either) is none of the three. Keep builder, reviewer and either as they are (the file's values).

assistant.template.badToken.defaultMessage: {name} uses {token}: an agent’s name may only hold '{key}' (the project’s key) and '{n}' (its number among the agents with that name).
assistant.template.badToken.description: Why a template file can't be used: an agent's name pattern ({name}) holds {token}, a token Combwork doesn't know. The quoted '{key}' and '{n}' are shown as {key} and {n}: keep them, with their straight quotes, as they are.

assistant.template.from09.defaultMessage: This template is from Combwork 0.9 and can't be loaded in 1.0. Recreate it from your agents with Save as Template.
assistant.template.from09.description: Why a template file can't be used: Hive 0.9 made it (its agents had worktrees of their own; 1.0's don't). Save as Template is a command: as Combwork names it.

assistant.template.longNote.defaultMessage: The note of agent {name} is over {max, number} characters.
assistant.template.longNote.description: Why a template file can't be used: an agent's note (what it is for, in the user's words) is too long. {max} is the limit, a number. A noun before the name (glossary §1 rule 4).

assistant.template.newer.defaultMessage: It was made by a newer version of Combwork: update Combwork to use it.
assistant.template.newer.description: Why a template file can't be used: a newer Combwork made it.

assistant.template.noAgents.description: Why a template file can't be used: it holds no agents.

assistant.template.noVersion.defaultMessage: It isn't a Combwork agent template (no version).
assistant.template.noVersion.description: Why a template file can't be used: it has no format version.

assistant.template.notTemplate.defaultMessage: It isn't a Combwork agent template.
assistant.template.notTemplate.description: Why a template file can't be used: it isn't one.

assistant.template.sameName.description: Why a template file can't be used: two agents share a name.

assistant.template.tooMany.defaultMessage: It has {count} agents; a project can have up to {max}.
assistant.template.tooMany.description: Why a template file can't be used: more agents than any project can have.

assistant.templateConnections.all.description: Stands for {who} in "Connection for {who}" (HI-2109): the Same for all choice. Lower case.

assistant.templateConnections.heading.description: Heading of the Load template and Choose Connections dialogs' section choosing which connection (a named setup on an account: model, effort, mode) the agents run on (HI-2109).

assistant.templateConnections.keep.description: Choose Connections (HI-2109): the first choice of a role's (or all agents') connection: each agent keeps the connection it has.

assistant.templateConnections.keepOwn.description: Choose Connections (HI-2109), an agent's own row: it keeps the connection it has ({name}).

assistant.templates.workflowFill.description: The Templates view's template editor (HI-1910): the accessible name of the drop-down that fills this version control's workflow section from a preset (Solo, Pair, Team, All off), its check names kept.

assistant.templates.workflowFillChoose.description: The Templates view's template editor (HI-1910): the drop-down's first entry, before a preset is chosen.

assistant.templates.workflowHead.description: The Templates view (HI-1910): the heading of a template's workflow options, a tab for each version control (None, Git). Glossary: workflow.

assistant.templates.workflowNone.defaultMessage: No workflow for {platform}: loading it leaves a {platform} project’s options as they are.
assistant.templates.workflowNone.description: The Templates view (HI-1910): the template has no workflow section for this version control ({platform}: None or Git).

assistant.templates.workflowPlatforms.description: The Templates view (HI-1910): the accessible name of the tabs choosing which version control's workflow (None, Git) a template's section shows.

assistant.templates.workflowPreset.defaultMessage: {preset, select, none {Not from a preset.} other {From the preset {name}.}}
assistant.templates.workflowPreset.description: The Templates view (HI-1910): which preset a template's workflow section started from ({name}: Solo, Pair, Team), or none. Glossary: preset.

assistant.templates.workflowRemove.description: The Templates view's template editor (HI-1910): a button removing this version control's workflow section from the template.

assistant.templates.workspace.description: A badge, a group and a filter: the workspace's templates (for every project).

assistant.undo.askFinal.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# change can't be undone, such as a prompt that was sent: it is listed with why.} other {# changes can't be undone, such as prompts that were sent: they are listed with why.}}
assistant.undo.askFinal.description: Under the question before a message's changes are undone, when some of them can't be.

assistant.undo.askMessage.defaultMessage: Changes made since by you or an agent are kept.
assistant.undo.askMessage.description: The question before the Assistant's changes for a message are undone: what someone changed afterwards isn't overwritten.

assistant.undo.askTitle.description: The question before every change the Assistant made for a message is undone.

assistant.undo.card.description: A change the Assistant made to a card ({card}: the card, "#12 Fix the login"; {fields}: what it changed, "labels and column").

assistant.undo.changed.description: Why undo left part of a change of the Assistant's as it is: someone (the user or an agent) changed it afterwards ({fields}: "labels", "title and column").

assistant.undo.dismiss.description: A button that closes the note under a message saying what its undo did.

assistant.undo.ended.description: Why undo left a change of the Assistant's to a lane (a card loop's record): the lane is over. Lower case.

assistant.undo.error.description: Why undo didn't put back part of a change of the Assistant's: it failed ({error}: Combwork's reason, in English). Lower case; Undo is offered again.

assistant.undo.failed.defaultMessage: Could not undo the Assistant's change
assistant.undo.failed.description: An error notice: undoing a change the Assistant made failed; the reason follows.

assistant.undo.field.defaultMessage: {field, select, title {title} description {description} labels {labels} blocked {blocked} blockedBy {blocked by} links {links} agent {agent} column {column} project {project} created {the card} cards {cards} reviewer {reviewer} rounds {rounds} waitMinutes {wait} name {name} provider {provider} connection {connection} model {model} effort {effort} permissionMode {permission mode} use200kContext {context size} mcpServers {MCP servers} lastSessionId {conversation} value {value} removed {removed models} run {the run} agents {agents} layout {layout} workflow {workflow options} other {{field}}}
assistant.undo.field.description: What part of something the Assistant changed (lower case, listed after a card or in why undo kept it): a card's title, labels, column…; a lane's cards, reviewer, rounds, wait; an agent's provider, model, effort…; a setting's value; run: an agent it started; agents, layout, workflow: a project's agents, page layout and workflow options a template's load replaced (HI-1502). Select keys: the field.

assistant.undo.final.description: Beside a change of the Assistant's that undo can't take back (a prompt sent, a comment); its tooltip says why.

assistant.undo.gone.description: Why undo left a change of the Assistant's: the card, lane or agent it was about no longer exists. Lower case.

assistant.undo.kept.description: Beside a change of the Assistant's that undo left as it is (someone changed it since, or it is gone); its tooltip says why.

assistant.undo.made.description: A card the Assistant made ({card}: "#12 Fix the login"); undo archives it.

assistant.undo.message.defaultMessage: Your message at {time}: {n, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}
assistant.undo.message.description: The heading of the Assistant's changes made for one message of the user's ({time}: when it was sent, a time, or a date and time before today; {n}: how many changes).

assistant.undo.messageNone.description: The heading of what the Assistant did for one message of the user's when it changed nothing ({time}: when it was sent).

assistant.undo.partly.description: Beside a change of the Assistant's when undo put back some of it and kept the rest (someone changed it since); its tooltip says what.

assistant.undo.resultAlready.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# undone before} other {# undone before}}
assistant.undo.resultAlready.description: What an undo of a message's changes did: how many were undone already.

assistant.undo.resultFinal.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# can't be undone:} other {# can't be undone:}}
assistant.undo.resultFinal.description: What an undo of a message's changes did: how many it couldn't take back, each listed after it with why.

assistant.undo.resultKept.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# kept as it is:} other {# kept as they are:}}
assistant.undo.resultKept.description: What an undo of a message's changes did: how many it left, each listed after it with why.

assistant.undo.resultLine.description: A change in what an undo did ({change}: the change; {why}: why it was kept, or can't be undone).

assistant.undo.resultUndone.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# change undone} other {# changes undone}}
assistant.undo.resultUndone.description: What an undo of a message's changes did: how many it put back.

assistant.undo.undo.description: A button: undoes a change the Assistant made (on its row), or every change it made for a message (on the message's heading).

assistant.undo.undoChange.description: A change's Undo button, for screen readers ({change}: the change, as its row says it).

assistant.undo.undoMessage.defaultMessage: Undo the changes for your message at {time}
assistant.undo.undoMessage.description: A message's Undo button, for screen readers ({time}: when the message was sent).

assistant.undo.undoneAt.description: Beside a change of the Assistant's that was undone ({when}: "5 minutes ago", lower case).

assistant.undo.why.agentAdded.defaultMessage: An agent it added stays: remove it in the project's agents if it isn't wanted.
assistant.undo.why.agentAdded.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: it added an agent to a project.

assistant.undo.why.agentStopped.defaultMessage: An agent it stopped isn't started again by undo: start it if it should run.
assistant.undo.why.agentStopped.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: it stopped an agent.

assistant.undo.why.ask.defaultMessage: Its question stays under For you: answer or dismiss it there.
assistant.undo.why.ask.description: What of a question the Assistant asked on a card stays when it is undone. For you: the board's section of what waits on the user (glossary).

assistant.undo.why.cannot.defaultMessage: Its request stays under For you: answer or dismiss it there.
assistant.undo.why.cannot.description: What of a request the Assistant made on a card stays when it is undone. For you: the board's section of what waits on the user (glossary).

assistant.undo.why.cardPlace.defaultMessage: The card's place in its column isn't put back.
assistant.undo.why.cardPlace.description: Why part of a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: it moved a card up or down its column.

assistant.undo.why.cardsOrder.defaultMessage: The cards' order isn't put back.
assistant.undo.why.cardsOrder.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: it put cards in order in a column.

assistant.undo.why.comment.defaultMessage: A comment stays: undo doesn't take back what was said.
assistant.undo.why.comment.description: Why part of a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: a comment on a card.

assistant.undo.why.connectionChanged.defaultMessage: A connection it changed isn't changed back: edit it in Settings → Accounts & Connections.
assistant.undo.why.connectionChanged.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone (HI-2108): it changed a connection's name, model, effort, context or mode. Settings → Accounts & Connections names a section.

assistant.undo.why.connectionMade.defaultMessage: A connection it made stays: remove it in Settings → Accounts & Connections if it isn't wanted.
assistant.undo.why.connectionMade.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone (HI-2108): it made a connection (a named setup of model, effort and mode on an account that agents choose). Settings → Accounts & Connections names a section.

assistant.undo.why.context.defaultMessage: The doc sections to read first stay as set.
assistant.undo.why.context.description: Why part of a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: it set a card's doc sections to read first.

assistant.undo.why.decision.defaultMessage: A decision it recorded stays: only you change or remove decisions.
assistant.undo.why.decision.description: Why part of a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: it recorded the user's decision on a card.

assistant.undo.why.declarePaths.defaultMessage: The paths it declared stay with the card.
assistant.undo.why.declarePaths.description: What of the Assistant declaring a card's paths stays when it is undone.

assistant.undo.why.freshRetried.defaultMessage: A lane agent's new conversation tried again isn't stopped by undo: end the lane if it isn't wanted.
assistant.undo.why.freshRetried.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone (HI-2034): it retried a lane agent's new conversation, which Combwork had stopped trying to start. Glossary: lane, conversation.

assistant.undo.why.handOver.defaultMessage: A hand-over can't be undone: the work went to the other agent.
assistant.undo.why.handOver.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: it handed an agent's work over to another.

assistant.undo.why.laneEnded.defaultMessage: A lane that ended stays ended: start it again if it should go on.
assistant.undo.why.laneEnded.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: it ended a lane (a card loop's record).

assistant.undo.why.laneReorderNow.defaultMessage: A card a lane reorder applied now put back stays in Todo: undo puts back only the lane's order.
assistant.undo.why.laneReorderNow.description: What of the Assistant's lane reorder applied now (HI-1995) stays when it is undone: the card it put back in the Todo column stays there; undo restores only the order of the lane's cards.

assistant.undo.why.message.defaultMessage: A message that was sent can't be taken back.
assistant.undo.why.message.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: it sent an agent a message.

assistant.undo.why.nothing.defaultMessage: It changed nothing undo puts back.
assistant.undo.why.nothing.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: nothing it did is something undo puts back.

assistant.undo.why.projectClosed.defaultMessage: A project it closed stays closed: open it again if it is wanted.
assistant.undo.why.projectClosed.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: it closed (deactivated) a project.

assistant.undo.why.projectMade.defaultMessage: A project it made stays: remove it from Combwork if it isn't wanted.
assistant.undo.why.projectMade.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: it created a project.

assistant.undo.why.projectOpened.defaultMessage: A project it opened stays open: close it if it isn't wanted.
assistant.undo.why.projectOpened.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: it opened (activated) a project.

assistant.undo.why.prompt.defaultMessage: A prompt that was sent can't be taken back.
assistant.undo.why.prompt.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: it prompted an agent.

assistant.undo.why.putBack.defaultMessage: Its reason stays as a comment.
assistant.undo.why.putBack.description: What of the Assistant putting a card back stays when it is undone: the reason it gave.

assistant.undo.why.queuePaused.defaultMessage: A merge queue it paused stays paused: resume it if it should run.
assistant.undo.why.queuePaused.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: it paused a project's merge queue.

assistant.undo.why.queueResumed.defaultMessage: A merge queue it resumed isn't paused again: pause it if it shouldn't run.
assistant.undo.why.queueResumed.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: it resumed a project's merge queue.

assistant.undo.why.removedFromQueue.defaultMessage: Taking it out of the merge queue stays in the card's work: it is queued again only by Retry merge or a new approval.
assistant.undo.why.removedFromQueue.description: What of the Assistant taking a card out of the merge queue stays when it is undone. Retry merge: a command on the card (use it as Combwork shows it).

assistant.undo.why.reportMerge.defaultMessage: The merge it reported stays in the card's work.
assistant.undo.why.reportMerge.description: What of a merge the Assistant reported stays when it is undone.

assistant.undo.why.request.defaultMessage: Its request to the builder stays as a comment.
assistant.undo.why.request.description: What of a request the Assistant made to a card's builder stays when it is undone.

assistant.undo.why.retriedMerge.defaultMessage: Its Retry merge stays in the card's work.
assistant.undo.why.retriedMerge.description: What of the Assistant's Retry merge on a card (a command that queues a returned card again) stays when it is undone.

assistant.undo.why.slotReleased.defaultMessage: A slot it released isn't kept or held again: the next work that needs a slot may take it.
assistant.undo.why.slotReleased.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: it released a slot (a folder cards are built in) that was kept for an agent or held by an agent's ended session.

assistant.undo.why.start.defaultMessage: Its start stays in the card's work: undo moves the card back, it doesn't unstart it.
assistant.undo.why.start.description: What of a card's start by the Assistant stays when it is undone.

assistant.undo.why.startReview.defaultMessage: The review it started stays in the card's work.
assistant.undo.why.startReview.description: What of a review the Assistant started stays when it is undone.

assistant.undo.why.submit.defaultMessage: Its submission stays in the card's work.
assistant.undo.why.submit.description: What of a card's submission for review by the Assistant stays when it is undone.

assistant.undo.why.teamPaused.defaultMessage: A team it paused stays paused: resume it if it should go on.
assistant.undo.why.teamPaused.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone (HI-2081): it paused its workspace's team before an update (Combwork starts no card and wakes no agent until it resumes).

assistant.undo.why.teamResumed.defaultMessage: A team it resumed isn't paused again: pause it if it should wait.
assistant.undo.why.teamResumed.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone (HI-2081): it resumed its workspace's team, which was paused before an update.

assistant.undo.why.templateCards.defaultMessage: The cards and lanes of the agents a template replaced stay as the load left them (cards put back, lanes ended): undo doesn't give them back.
assistant.undo.why.templateCards.description: What of the Assistant loading a template into a project (it replaced the project's agents) stays when it is undone: the replaced agents' open cards were put back and their lanes ended (HI-1502).

assistant.undo.why.verdict.defaultMessage: Its verdict stays in the card's work, and its round with it.
assistant.undo.why.verdict.description: What of a review verdict by the Assistant stays when it is undone.

assistant.undo.why.withdrawn.defaultMessage: Messages it withdrew aren't sent again.
assistant.undo.why.withdrawn.description: Why a change of the Assistant's can't be undone: it withdrew messages waiting for an agent.

assistant.undo.working.description: The Undo button of the question while the changes are being undone.

assistant.view.addMcp.description: The Assistant view's MCP Servers section (HI-2059): the + button that opens the picker of the workspace's servers to add.

assistant.view.allAttachments.description: The Assistant view: the row that shows the files attached to its conversations.

assistant.view.allConversations.description: The Assistant view: the row that shows the Assistant's conversations.

assistant.view.attachments.description: The Assistant view: the section of the files attached to its conversations.

assistant.view.conversations.description: The Assistant view: the section of the Assistant's conversations.

assistant.view.digests.description: The Assistant view, Journal: the row that shows only the Assistant's weekly digests.

assistant.view.journal.description: The Assistant view: the section of the Assistant's journal (its memory across sessions).

assistant.view.journalTip.defaultMessage: What the Assistant keeps in its journal (decisions, plans, what happened and why) and Combwork's own facts. Search it, correct it, or forget what you'd rather it didn't keep.
assistant.view.journalTip.description: The Assistant view: the info tip of its Journal section.

assistant.view.mcp.description: The Assistant view (HI-2059): the section of the workspace's MCP servers added for the Assistant. MCP is a protocol's name: keep it.

assistant.view.mcpTip.defaultMessage: The workspace's MCP servers the Assistant gets, as a project's MCP tab has them: add one with +, Remove takes it off the Assistant only. Applies from its next session.
assistant.view.mcpTip.description: The Assistant view: the info tip of its MCP Servers section (HI-2059). "MCP tab" as Combwork names it; + is the add button.

assistant.view.modes.description: The Assistant view: the section of the Assistant's modes (how it works: Advisor, Builder…).

assistant.view.newMode.description: The Assistant view, Modes: a button that creates a mode.

assistant.view.noMcp.description: The Assistant view's MCP Servers section (HI-2059) when none is added for the Assistant.

assistant.view.noWorkspace.defaultMessage: Open a workspace to see its Assistant.
assistant.view.noWorkspace.description: The Assistant view with no workspace open.

assistant.view.noWorkspaceMain.defaultMessage: Open a workspace to see its Assistant's conversations.
assistant.view.noWorkspaceMain.description: The Assistant view's main area with no workspace open.

assistant.view.openFolder.description: The Assistant view, Modes: a button that opens the modes' folder in Explorer.

assistant.view.period.description: The Assistant view: the accessible name of the period buttons (Today, 7 days…).

assistant.view.refresh.description: The Assistant view, Modes: a button that reads the modes again.

assistant.view.removeMcp.description: The Assistant view's MCP Servers section (HI-2059): the button on a server that removes it from the Assistant. {name} is the server.

assistant.view.showPanel.description: The Assistant view: a button that opens the Assistant's panel on the right.

assistant.view.statConversations.description: The Assistant view, Used so far: how many conversations.

assistant.view.statCost.description: The Assistant view, Used so far: what it cost at API prices.

assistant.view.statPrompts.description: The Assistant view, Used so far: how many prompts were sent.

assistant.view.statTokens.description: The Assistant view, Used so far: tokens used.

assistant.view.summaryTip.defaultMessage: What this workspace's Assistant has used across its conversations, in the period chosen (by calendar day: Today is since midnight). It isn't counted in any project's Overview. The cost is what the work would have cost at API prices: on a subscription you are not charged this.
assistant.view.summaryTip.description: The Assistant view: tooltip on Used so far. Today and Overview as Combwork names them.

assistant.view.timeline.description: The Assistant view, Journal: the row that shows every journal entry, newest first.

assistant.view.title.description: The Assistant view's heading in the sidebar. Combwork's name stays as it is.

assistant.view.titleTip.defaultMessage: Your workspace's overseer: what it has used, its modes, its conversations and the files attached to them. Its panel is on the right (Ctrl+Alt+I); its defaults are in Settings → Assistant.
assistant.view.titleTip.description: The Assistant view: tooltip on its heading. Keep the shortcut as it is.

assistant.view.unpriced.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# conversation without a price} other {# conversations without a price}}
assistant.view.unpriced.description: The Assistant view: tooltip on Cost when some conversations' models have no known price.

assistant.view.usedSoFar.description: The Assistant view: the heading of what the Assistant has used (tokens, cost).
